workflowDefinition.name: Antibody Antigen Complex
workflowDefinition.description: Boltz-2 antibody-antigen co-folding. Predicts the Fv-antigen 3D complex for each antibody (VH+VL, or VH-only for a nanobody/VHH/single-domain) against one or more antigen chains, fanned out one GPU task per antibody for parallel folding on AWS Batch. Reports Boltz-2 interface confidence (pair_chains_iptm between the antibody and each antigen) as the binding-interface readout, plus complex iptm/pLDDT and the predicted CIF structures. Handles monospecific antibodies and scFv, nanobodies/VHH, and bispecific arms (two antigens scored separately). Input: antibodies [{id,vh,vl?}] + antigen chains {label:sequence}. Output: complex CIF + confidence JSON + per-antibody interface_iptm summary.

workflowDefinition.description: ProFam is a protein family language model for variant fitness scoring and novel sequence generation conditioned on a protein family multiple sequence alignment (MSA) or reference FASTA. workflowDefinition.annotation: ProFam is a protein family language model for variant fitness scoring and novel sequence generation conditioned on a protein family multiple sequence alignment (MSA) or reference FASTA. Score variants against family fitness landscape, or sample new sequences at a given temperature. Input: conditioning FASTA (family MSA or reference) + candidate sequences FASTA/CSV (for scoring) or MSA alone (for generation). Output: ranked fitness scores CSV or generated FASTA.

suggestions: Use '1LYZ.fasta' as the conditioning reference sequence and 'enzyme_candidates.fasta' as the candidate sequences to score variant fitness using ProFam.

ProFam is a sequence-based language model. Since your goal is active-site pocket redesign with specific structural constraints (preserving catalytic Glu35/Asp52 and disulfide cysteines), a structure-based workflow such as ProteinMPNN is strongly recommended instead.
If you switch to a structure-based design workflow like ProteinMPNN, use '1LYZ.pdb' as the structural input. Do not use 'enzyme_constraints.json' as a direct structure input.

Please note that the provided files are public tutorial inputs containing explicitly unmeasured variants. Any predicted activity or thermostability changes will have inherent uncertainty and should not be claimed as experimentally measured improvements.

Predicts the Fv-antigen 3D complex for each antibody (VH+VL, or VH-only for a nanobody/VHH/single-domain) against one or more antigen chains, fanned out one GPU task per antibody for parallel folding on AWS Batch. Output: complex CIF + confidence JSON + per-antibody interface_iptm summary.

workflowDefinition.description: Boltz-2 antibody-antigen co-folding. Predicts the Fv-antigen 3D complex for each antibody (VH+VL, or VH-only for a nanobody/VHH/single-domain) against one or more antigen chains, fanned out one GPU task per antibody for parallel folding on AWS Batch. Reports Boltz-2 interface confidence (pair_chains_iptm between the antibody and each antigen) as the binding-interface readout, plus complex iptm/pLDDT and the predicted CIF structures. Handles monospecific antibodies and scFv, nanobodies/VHH, and bispecific arms (two antigens scored separately). Input: antibodies [{id,vh,vl?}] + antigen chains {label:sequence}. Output: complex CIF + confidence JSON + per-antibody interface_iptm summary.

Honesty contract: a step without its tools/GPU is held with null numerics, never a fabricated ΔΔG.
